options.name: Standing in Plurality
options.note: Most literal standing-person treatment; the circular field separates the human from the detailed logo.

options.name: Open Arms
options.note: Selected default: no enclosing circle; the Plurality colors move to exposed, inset squares while the outstretched human remains clear at 16 pixels.

options.name: Human Portrait
options.note: Strongest face/profile recognition at small sizes, though less expressive of a whole human body.

options.name: Full Human
options.note: A compact full-body silhouette; the vertical capsule protects it from background detail.

options.name: Human in Color
options.note: Warmest and most recognizably human at larger sizes, but intentionally included as the detail-heavy small-size comparison.

options.name: Human at the Center
options.note: Original art: a human is held inside a plural ring rather than covering the exact Plurality logo.

options.name: Shared Humanity
options.note: Original art: overlapping plural fields create the shared space from which the human portrait emerges.
